action.objective: ,Verify e2e4 as the reserved candidate, then commit it if it stands up.
action.rationale: ,Broad depth-2 search rated e2e4 as the top exact move (score 47); f4g3/h1g1 are only upper bounds. The reserved verification slot for e2e4 (2000 nodes) lets me test it at full depth with a mate-safety probe before committing. Prior O-O-O was played and Black answered Be6, so developing the center with e4 claims space and opens the f1 bishop.
